primary-boundary-figure: \caption{SYNTHETIC REHEARSAL, NOT A RESULT. Detection boundary $a^*(r)$ against the confirmatory null family B (trait-plus-autoregressive persistence) and the secondary families A (autoregressive persistence), C (autoregressive persistence with an altered response channel), D (state-dependent persistence) and E (mover--stayer persistence). The horizontal axis is the continuous response signal share $r$; the vertical axis is the nominal partner-drift strength $a$ at the positions of the frozen grid, so equal spacing does not denote equal increments of $a$, and nothing is interpolated. Filled circles give $a^*$ and bars its interval by inclusive inversion of the per-$r$ band; open circles give the sustained boundary $a_s^*$ of B. Triangles: not reached on the complete eligible grid; open squares: censored at a gap; the strip below marks units without a valid curve. Gray B markers in the other panels are a descriptive reference, not a between-family inference. Bands are simultaneous over the strengths of one $r$ only. \dag marks the calibration-exposed $r$.}\label{fig:v4-F1}
